storyline.label: Z.ai Alpha
storyline.latest_title: Everything we know about Z.ai, the Chinese company behind the mysterious Ox Alpha model

prior_narrative.tldr: Z.ai CEO Jie Tang laid out GLM 5.3's post-training scaling-law approach the same day an independent hands-on review covered GLM 5's features and pricing. Two days later, the company confirmed the follow-up release wasn't shipping on schedule.
prior_narrative.whats_new: Z.ai delayed the GLM 5.3 release over cybersecurity risks, per BetaNews's Aug 22 report.
prior_narrative.why_it_matters: Platform engineers evaluating GLM 5.3 as an open-weight option should expect a slipped release date and treat any leaked or early build with extra scrutiny until Z.ai discloses what triggered the review.

status.detail: GLM 5.3's release is on hold pending a security review; Z.ai has not disclosed the specific risk or a new ship date.

beats.headline: Z.ai's CEO frames GLM 5.3 around a new post-training scaling law
A hands-on review covers GLM 5's features and pricing
GLM 5.3 release delayed over cybersecurity risks

open_questions: What specific cybersecurity risk triggered the delay, and has Z.ai disclosed it?
Does GLM 5.3 ship with the post-training scaling-law approach CEO Jie Tang described, or does the security review change the release scope?
prior_narrative.take_for_builders: Hold off pinning a GLM 5.3 version until Z.ai names a new release date, and track its disclosures for the specific cybersecurity risk before evaluating it as a coding backend.
